params.name: AccountSID
params.description: Unique identifier for the partner account.

params.name: Keyword
params.description: Keyword to search for across all catalog item fields (name, description, manufacturer, etc.). If omitted, all items across all catalogs are returned.

params.name: PageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page. Defaults to 100.

params.name: Page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (1-based). Use with `PageSize` to paginate through large result sets.

items.docs: Searches for items across all available catalogs using a keyword. Unlike the per-catalog `/Items` endpoint, this endpoint searches across all catalogs in a single request and returns a paginated list of matching items.
